note: Ashley NF campground on the far northwest shore of Flaming Gorge Reservoir, 25 mi S of Green River on WY-530 then 2 mi E on FR 009, next to Buckboard Marina (boat ramp, slips, restaurant, groceries). Open high-desert sagebrush with little natural shade; most sites have a shade cabana. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS current. $33 / $45 electric (7 loop-A sites, 50 A), 2 vehicles max, dump fee. 58 sites (39 reservable, 19 FCFS), most take 25 ft, max 45. Flush toilets, showers, water, dump. 2027 season 05-15..09-15. 16-night max, 4-day cutoff. Senior discount single sites. Lakeview stands (~215 m to the high-water bench, open sage, no trees between). Pin fine. Phone empty -> 801-226-3564.
flags: WATERFRONT 'lakeview' STANDS (checked hard): on imagery the loops sit in open sagebrush on a rise; the nearest sites (loop A 1/2 at 41.24791,-109.60212 / 41.24784,-109.60194) are ~215 m from the reservoir's high-water bench (the bleached shoreline band) to the south and ~260 m from the water at the imagery's lower pool, with only sage and the loop road between - no trees or buildings block the view. Not on-water (well over 50 m).
